name: bmstu-thesis-checker
description: Local BMSTU VKR thesis checker for DOCX/PDF formatting, structure, images, and dictionary issues.

interface.shortDescription: Check thesis DOCX/PDF files for BMSTU-style issues.
interface.longDescription: Runs a local clean-room rules engine derived from TestVkr reverse-engineering signals and BMSTU/GOST-style formatting requirements. It checks structure, Word/PDF formatting, images, dictionary and homoglyph issues, and returns severity, confidence, thresholds, and locations when available.
defaultPrompt: Check this thesis DOCX for BMSTU issues.
